product.title: Zion Full Day Private Tour & Hike

description.text: Explore Zion National Park on a private full-day tour tailored to your hiking ability and sightseeing priorities. A certified guide leads your party through canyon viewpoints, emerald pool trails, and optional Narrows wading when river conditions allow. Travel in a private vehicle with flexible stops at Court of the Patriarchs, Zion Lodge, and scenic pullouts along the canyon floor. This premium outing suits travelers who want a personalized Zion introduction without joining a large bus group.

highlights: Private full-day Zion tour for your party only
Certified guide adjusts hikes to group fitness
Optional Narrows wading when conditions permit
Emerald Pools and Court of the Patriarchs stops
Flexible vehicle routing through Zion Canyon

start.description: Meet your guide at the Zion Outfitter staging area in Springdale, UT 84767. Confirm pickup time and hiking preferences when booking.

end.description: Return to Springdale or your Zion area hotel after the final canyon stop.

product.itinerarySummary: Explore Zion National Park on a private full-day tour tailored to your hiking ability and sightseeing priorities.

itineraryItems.title: Zion National Park
itineraryItems.description: Begin with a canyon overview and shuttle or private vehicle access to major trailheads.

itineraryItems.title: Virgin River
itineraryItems.description: Optional wading section toward the Narrows when flow levels are safe for your group.

itineraryItems.title: Emerald Pools
itineraryItems.description: Hike the lower or middle Emerald Pools trail for waterfall views beneath sandstone cliffs.

itineraryItems.title: Court of the Patriarchs
itineraryItems.description: Photo stop at the Court of the Patriarchs viewpoint above the canyon road.

itineraryItems.title: The Narrows
itineraryItems.description: Bottom-up Narrows hike from Riverside Walk when river permits allow.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.answer: The planned duration is 6 to 10 hours.
